arguments.premise_synthesis: The LTCM failure in 1998 led to a bank-orchestrated bailout. The 2008 financial crisis led to a taxpayer bailout of banks. The 2020 crisis led to large-scale printing and a massive increase in government debt, with the US government taking on trillions in extra debt. Each crisis is bigger and absorbed by the entity that handled the previous one, which in the case of 2020 was the taxpayer and government itself. This pattern indicates that the next crisis will be a sovereign debt crisis.
